title: Common Architecture Language Model Interfaces
description: The interfaces a node exposes, and the reference from one end of a connection to a node and its interfaces.

interface-definition.description: A modular interface definition referencing an external schema

unique-id.description: Unique identifier for this interface instance

definition-url.description: URI of the external schema this interface configuration conforms to

config.description: Inline configuration conforming to the external interface schema

interface-type.description: An interface given by its own keys, such as a host and port, rather than by an external schema.

unique-id.description: The interface's identifier, unique within the architecture.

node-interface.description: One end of a connection, naming a node and, optionally, which of its interfaces.

node.description: The unique-id of the node at this end.

interfaces.description: The unique-ids of the node's interfaces this end uses.
